de.short: Die PDF beschreibt Retrieve/Subscribe/Unsubscribe für TripRef und TripInformation; die Service-XSD enthält service-spezifisch nur die Retrieve-Roots/-Gruppeneinträge.
de.long: TSD-001 ist ein bestätigter PDF/XSD-Modellierungskonflikt in TrainSetDataService V2.1. en.title: TrainSetDataService V2.1: documented subscription operations are absent from the service-specific XSD operation layer
en.short: The PDF documents Retrieve/Subscribe/Unsubscribe for TripRef and TripInformation; the service XSD contains only service-specific Retrieve roots/group members.
en.long: TSD-001 is a confirmed PDF/XSD modelling mismatch in TrainSetDataService V2.1. The official writing describes Retrieve, Subscribe and Unsubscribe operations for both TripRef and TripInformation. The exact service XSD, however, exposes only the service-specific Retrieve roots and matching TrainSetDataServiceOperations members. At the same time, Common V2.0 provides the generic Subscribe/Unsubscribe structures. Subscription infrastructure is therefore not absent as a whole; the gap is specifically in service-specific root/operation modelling.
en.recommendation: Preserve the documented V2.1 context for discovery and code generation, but do not synthesize missing TrainSetDataService.Subscribe*/Unsubscribe* roots. Keep the selected XSD family authoritative for XML validation and retain this as modelling/discovery guidance.

de.short: Die Übersicht nennt Retrieve*RequestStructure; Detailbeschreibung und XSD verlangen TrainSetUnsubscribeRequestStructure.
de.long: TSD-002 ist ein ausführbar bestätigter Dokumentationsfehler. en.long: TSD-002 is an executably confirmed documentation defect. semantic_basis.note: The V2.2 operation group types SubscribeTripRefResponse and SubscribeTripInformationResponse as generic SubscribeResponseStructure, while the corresponding global response roots use RetrieveTripRefResponseStructure and RetrieveTripInformationResponseStructure.
General Conventions V2.2 distinguishes generic subscription acknowledgement semantics from later subscription data delivery and explains when Retrieve-related data can be subscribed.

TrainSetDataService V2.2 explicitly extends the subscription concept for parameter-related Retrieve operations and describes the immediate SubscribeResponseStructure acknowledgement followed by event-based updates.
EV-104 and EV-160 reconfirm the group/global typing split and support it as intentional context rather than an XSD defect.
The two response types represent different phases of the same subscription lifecycle. Collapsing them into one type or treating the difference as an inconsistency would erase intended semantics.

de.title: TrainSetDataService V2.2: unterschiedliche Subscribe-Response-Typen bilden zwei Phasen ab
de.short: SubscribeResponseStructure bestätigt das Abonnement unmittelbar; spätere Ereignisdaten verwenden die jeweilige Retrieve-Response-Struktur.
de.long: TSD-003 ist kein Defekt. In TrainSetDataService V2.2 wird der unmittelbare Response der Subscribe-Operation in der Operationsgruppe mit der generischen SubscribeResponseStructure modelliert. Die globalen SubscribeTripRefResponse-/SubscribeTripInformationResponse-Roots verwenden dagegen die passenden Retrieve-Response-Strukturen für spätere ereignisbasierte Datenaktualisierungen. General Conventions V2.2 und die service-spezifische Erweiterung erklären diesen Lebenszyklus; EV-104/EV-160 bestätigen die XSD-Modellierung.
de.recommendation: Immediate Subscription-Acknowledgement und spätere Event-Payloads getrennt modellieren. Die unterschiedlichen Typen nicht vereinheitlichen, nicht als XSD-Inkonsistenz melden und keine Runtime-Warnung allein aus dieser Typdifferenz erzeugen.

en.title: TrainSetDataService V2.2: different Subscribe response types represent two phases
en.short: SubscribeResponseStructure acknowledges the subscription immediately; later event data uses the corresponding Retrieve response structure.
en.long: TSD-003 is not a defect. In TrainSetDataService V2.2, the immediate response of the Subscribe operation is modelled in the operation group with the generic SubscribeResponseStructure. The global SubscribeTripRefResponse / SubscribeTripInformationResponse roots instead use the matching Retrieve response structures for later event-based data updates. General Conventions V2.2 and the service-specific extension explain this lifecycle, and EV-104/EV-160 confirm the XSD modelling.
en.recommendation: Model the immediate subscription acknowledgement separately from later event payloads. Do not collapse the two types, report the distinction as an XSD inconsistency, or create a runtime warning solely from this type difference.
